title: Kyoto to Tokyo: See the experience and choose together
destination: Kyoto, Uji, the Mount Fuji area and Tokyo
intro: See real photos and winter videos before choosing interested or not interested independently. You do not need to know your preferred travel category first. Details explain crowds, queues, cold weather, walking, reservations and seasonal tradeoffs. This is an exploration menu, not an itinerary to complete.

nanzenji-aqueduct.title: Walk beside Nanzenji's red-brick aqueduct
nanzenji-aqueduct.description: Walk a short stretch beside the working aqueduct and notice its brickwork and light. Popular compositions may attract people waiting for photos; this suits accepting other visitors in the frame rather than waiting for an empty scene.
nanzenji-aqueduct.imageAlt: Nanzenji's repeated red-brick aqueduct arches and gravel ground
nanzenji-aqueduct.imageCredit: JNTO; photographer not separately identified on the source page

tokichi-bamboo-parfait.description: Work down through the patterned matcha top and layered sweets in a bamboo cup. This is a cold dessert rather than hot tea. The Uji cafe does not take seating reservations, and waiting may take longer than eating.

kawaguchiko-day-shore.title: Take a daytime lakeside walk at Kawaguchiko's Ubuyagasaki
kawaguchiko-day-shore.description: Walk slowly along the shore at Ubuyagasaki, leaving time to sit or find an angle you enjoy. The photographer visited on December 28, 2025; the clear snow-capped view was that day’s condition, and clouds can hide Fuji.
kawaguchiko-day-shore.imageAlt: Lake water, distant mountains and snow-capped Fuji from Ubuyagasaki in winter

kakimori-order-notebook.title: Choose a cover and paper for a custom notebook at Kakimori
kakimori-order-notebook.description: Each of you chooses a cover, paper and fastener, then staff bind a notebook to take home. Choosing materials is part of the experience, rather than assuming this is quick shopping without a wait.
kakimori-order-notebook.imageAlt: Kakimori spiral notebooks with different cover patterns and materials

gion-winter-street.title: Walk the machiya streets around Gion's Hanamikoji
gion-winter-street.description: Look at wooden townhouses from public streets, accepting that vehicles and pedestrians also use them. The video shows an actual weekend visit on December 6, 2025, with people and traffic rather than an empty promotional street.

facts.cost: Public-street walk; food and purchases cost extra.

tokichi-tea-grinding.title: Grind matcha with a stone mill and try tea ceremony in Uji
tokichi-tea-grinding.description: Turn a stone mill by hand to grind tea leaves, then join a thin-matcha tea experience in the shop’s tea room. Choose this for hands-on interest in how a bowl of tea is made. Advance booking is required.
tokichi-tea-grinding.imageAlt: Hands turning a stone mill to grind tea leaves
tokichi-tea-grinding.imageCredit: 中村藤吉本店 official photograph (no separate photographer credited on the page)

facts.seasonalNote: This is the approximately 60-minute program for 1–4 guests; two may participate. Japanese Otonami currently offers Sunday, Wednesday and Thursday sessions. English/other-language dates may differ; check Wabunka’s calendar and language arrangements separately.

fuji-ropeway-view.title: See Lake Kawaguchi and the town from the cable-car window
fuji-ropeway-view.description: Ride up Mount Tenjo for a higher viewpoint. This means paying for the view and accepting waiting time. Clouds can hide Fuji; the lake remains visible, but the complete mountain view is not assured.
fuji-ropeway-view.imageAlt: Cable lines beside a cabin window above Lake Kawaguchi and the town
fuji-ropeway-view.imageCredit: JNTO; photographer not separately identified on the source page

facts.seasonalNote: Wind, weather or maintenance can stop operation; a December 2025 travelogue encountered a maintenance closure. The photo shows a leafy season, not December vegetation.

kappabashi-sample-making.title: Make wax tempura and lettuce food models in Kappabashi
kappabashi-sample-making.description: Turn wax into realistic tempura and lettuce, taking home your own creations. This class requires reservations and currently uses Japanese; the official rules require an accompanying interpreter if you cannot communicate in Japanese.
kappabashi-sample-making.imageAlt: Wax food models of tempura and layered lettuce
kappabashi-sample-making.imageCredit: Ganso Shokuhin Sample-ya / IWASAKI official photograph
kappabashi-sample-making.sourceTitle: Ganso Shokuhin Sample-ya | Kappabashi class and participation conditions

facts.duration: Planning estimate: Official class duration about 40 minutes; arrive 10 minutes early
facts.cost: JPY 3,300 per person at review, plus any interpreter arrangements. Confirm December availability.
facts.mobility: Indoor handwork involving warm water. Each slot is limited to six participants and may be shared with others.
facts.seasonalNote: Only schedule after confirming December sessions and language arrangements. The models are not edible, and results may differ from the demonstration photo.

nishiki-market-browse.title: Browse dried foods, pickles and Kyoto ingredients at Nishiki Market
nishiki-market-browse.description: Browse stalls for pickles, dried goods and freshly made food, then choose a few things to buy. This is a December 29, 2025 year-end walk showing the aisle, stalls and pedestrians; its crowd level is not a forecast for your dates.

tokichi-matcha-castella.title: Buy deep-green matcha castella in Uji
tokichi-matcha-castella.description: Choose matcha sponge cake with a fine crumb to enjoy with tea back at your accommodation. This is a take-away baked sweet, a different choice from waiting for a cafe parfait.

oshino-water-walk.title: Walk beside clear spring water and streams at Oshino Hakkai
oshino-water-walk.description: Look at clear water, stream beds and village scenery, accepting an extra journey for a different Fuji-area experience. The official guide describes a popular, often-busy destination; a December traveler disliked the tour groups and commercial atmosphere, which may matter if quiet is your priority.
oshino-water-walk.sourceTitle: JNTO | Oshino Hakkai and visitor crowds

roppongi-winter-lights.title: Walk Keyakizaka's blue-white lights with Tokyo Tower in view
roppongi-winter-lights.description: Walk under the lights and find a view including Tokyo Tower. A December vlogger filmed many people gathering at crossings and found it crowded. Choose this as a winter evening together only if that bustle is acceptable.
roppongi-winter-lights.sourceTitle: Mori Building | Roppongi Hills Christmas 2026 announcement, September 30, 2026

fushimi-inari-short-torii.title: Walk a short stretch of Fushimi Inari's red torii tunnel
fushimi-inari-short-torii.description: Walk through repeated red gates to notice their color and light, turning back when satisfied. This is a short walk, not climbing all of Mount Inari. The entrance area can be crowded; an empty photo is not the premise.

mishima-suspension-bridge.title: Walk Mishima Skywalk's 400-meter suspension bridge
mishima-suspension-bridge.description: Cross the long bridge for valley and Suruga Bay views, with Fuji possible in clear weather. It can be researched as an extra stop between Kyoto and Tokyo, but requires another journey; do not automatically combine it with all of Kawaguchiko in one day.
mishima-suspension-bridge.imageAlt: The central Mishima Skywalk deck, railings and tall suspension cables
mishima-suspension-bridge.sourceTitle: Mishima Skywalk | Tickets, opening and facilities

facts.seasonalNote: Fuji visibility and bridge access depend on weather and official notices. The photo shows a leafy season. Mishima and Kawaguchiko view different sides of Fuji and need separate transport checks.

mishima-rakujuen-garden.title: Look at lava rock and the old villa at Rakujuen, Mishima
mishima-rakujuen-garden.description: Walk through this park beside Mishima Station to see an old villa and volcanic rock. Rocks are more exposed when the pond has little water in winter; choose this for its geology rather than a full summer pond.

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 45–75 min; regional transfers extra

facts.mobility: Garden paths; walk around stones, roots and small slopes as needed.
